_comment: How drafting agents with a shell (Codex, oss) run this project's checks in their sandboxed copy: no secrets, no network. See ~/.claude/skills/draft-agents.

tests.hint: Agents run only the restricted command set: `tools/mm.py agent test` (unit tests of tools/ and, once they exist, cargo tests) and `tools/mm.py agent check` (offline checks). Until tools/mm.py exists, run `-m unittest discover -s tools/tests -v`. The final OK / FAILED line is what counts.
